## Problem

Describe the expected behavior and what happened.

## Reproduction

Include the repository version, relevant file, agent/runtime version, exact steps,
and a minimal synthetic input. Remove private data and credentials.

## Evidence and impact

Include the command output or artifact that demonstrates the problem and explain
which workflow or decision it affects. Report security vulnerabilities using SECURITY.md.
